'''Dariana Frayus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] matriarch of [[House Frayus]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> She used the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Claw (Human)|Claw]], the leader of a local hooligan band and her son.<ref name="Kingpin" />
